rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “statewide” means throughout the whole country.

example.english: The new policy is now in effect statewide.
example.traditional: 呢項新政策已經喺全國生效。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3 ji5 ging1 hai2 cyun4 gwok3 sang1 haau6

rows.note: Use this when the territory is a U.S.-style state or another political subdivision called a 州.

example.english: The snowstorm has closed schools statewide today.
example.traditional: 場大雪令成個州嘅學校今日都停課。
example.jyutping: coeng4 daai6 syut3 ling6 seng4 go3 zau1 ge3 hok6 haau6 gam1 jat6 dou1 ting4 fo3
